scope: Post-review descriptive apparatus-aware source comparison, not a new classifier

reference.checked: relevant complete pages extracted and visually inspected; C435 original photographs not inspected

tests.question: Does source agreement with edited C435 identify agreement with the reported unedited witness at the invitatory?
tests.target: No separate pium visible under usual christogram expansion.
tests.reported_C435_manuscript: includes pium, apparatus line171 and C23 apparatus line742
tests.outcome: Edited-text agreement hides a reported manuscript-state difference. No physical identity or transmission branch established.

tests.question: Does the visible phrase order distinguish the reported states?
tests.reported_C435_manuscript: procidamus congementes precedes matri sue condolentes, as reported in the apparatus
tests.outcome: Provisional source order agrees with the standard/edited order, while differing from the reported C435 manuscript state. This is not a distinctive C23 fingerprint.

tests.question: Can the edition hymn entry or melody be silently supplied to this source?
tests.target: Visible transition from invitatory/psalm to nocturn antiphon without an intervening hymn entry.
tests.C435_edition: Rogatus Deus rumpere at this position
tests.C23_edition: O rosa fragrantissima at this position
tests.outcome: No. Written contents differ in scope; book function, abbreviations or a hymn supplied elsewhere are alternatives. No liturgical-performance omission inferred.

limits: The reported manuscript readings are editorial assertions, not our inspection of C435/C23 originals.
Negative apparatus does not license silent reconstruction of every unlisted witness.
No rarity/frequency, transmission stemma, new manuscript relation or melodic variant established.
All readings/tests selected after prior review; no new untouched evaluation.
